overview_description.description:
Everyme is a social networking app that provides its users with a mode to communicate with groups free of charge across the world. It is available on both mobile devices and the web.

 
 Everyme is an alternative to SMS groups, and it enables its users to customize their group's settings, manage people who have access to the things they share, and gives them control over notifications than in texting. In addition, with comments and cross-platform video and photo sharing, Everyme provides a greater depth of communication than texting does.

 
 It provides a user-friendly privacy policy and model and the users can export the data and remove at any time as the sole ownership of the shared content lies at the app user.

 
 The mobile app is available for both Android-powered mobile devices and Apple iOS-based smart phones, and it can be downloaded from Google Play and Apple App Store respectively.

 
 The company is a self-funded startup based in San Francisco, California, U.S.
